notes.title: Final version of Spellcrafter is here!
notes.notes: A big thank you goes to the community for helping us make the game better during the Early Access stage! Today we give you the final version of the game - it features many changes suggested by players who were testing the game during the Eearly Access period. Thank you for your support and hope you will enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update - Version 1.4!
notes.notes:
Hi! 
 
New version just arrived, hope you guys like it! 
 
New stuff: 
 
- Manual camera 
 
- All the animations are made with motion capture 
 
- New sounds and music themes 
 
- Cutscenes with Voice - overs 
 
- 7 differed languages 
 
- Manny small improvements.

notes.title: Update - Version 1.15!
notes.notes:
Tweaked and polished many aspects of the game. 
 
- Many changes in the story of the game, new dialogs.  
- New shaders for characters 
- New tooltips and explanations 
 
Bugfixing 
- Fights getting blocked because of collisions on battlefield fixed 
 
 
Hope you like this update, with new update you will get: 
- Final sounds and music 
- Final animations made with motion capture technology 
and much more - stay toned :)

notes.title: BIG update! Version 1.10 is here.
notes.notes:
Hi!  
 
This time it's huge improvement, especially in the aspect of battles:  
 
- More interesting battlefields with big obstacles that force player to modify his tactic with every battle.  
- Units no longer move after you move, the turns are determined by comparing dexterity parameter.  
- Spell Cards are working now, so you can cast spells using them.  
 
Other Features:  
- Tooltips in skilltree added  
- Credits in the main menu added  
 
Other Improvements:  
- Shaders on characters improved
